workarounds.symptom: GRPOTrainer and RLOOTrainer fail to load a reward model given by name when the policy is pinned to a commit
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Load a reward model given by name without the policy's revision. Target files: trl/experimental/online_dpo/online_dpo_config.py, trl/experimental/online_dpo/online_dpo_trainer.py, trl/experimental/sdpo/sdpo_config.py. This PR stops GRPO, RLOO and the experimental SDPO and Online DPO from passing the policy's revision to a reward model given by name and to its tokenizer. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8538)

workarounds.symptom: SFT (prompt-completion), DPO and KTO fail with vision-language models on AWS Trainium since `pad_to_multiple_of` defaults to 128 there
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Support `pad_to_multiple_of` with vision-language models in SFT, DPO and KTO. Target files: trl/trainer/dpo_trainer.py, trl/trainer/kto_trainer.py, trl/trainer/sft_trainer.py. This PR pads the vision-language batches of SFT (prompt-completion data), DPO and KTO to `pad_to_multiple_of` instead of raising `NotImplementedError`, so vision-language training works again on AWS Trainium, where `pad_to_multiple_of` defaults to 128. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8553)

workarounds.symptom: [GRPO] AssertionError in vLLM when using QLoRA (4-bit) due to weight shape mismatch during merge_adapter
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Merge LoRA adapters out of place for the vLLM weight sync. Target files: trl/experimental/async_distillation/async_distillation_trainer.py, trl/experimental/online_dpo/online_dpo_trainer.py, trl/generation/vllm_client.py. , #7423, #4973 (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8269)

workarounds.symptom: OnlineDPOTrainer documents processing_class as optional but rejects omission
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Load the processing class in OnlineDPOTrainer when it is omitted. Target files: trl/experimental/online_dpo/online_dpo_trainer.py, tests/experimental/test_online_dpo_trainer.py. `OnlineDPOTrainer` documents `processing_class` as optional, but it raised a `ValueError` when the argument was left out. This PR removes that check and loads the processor from the model's name, using the same block as `GRPOTrainer`. RLOO, DPO and 13 of the 17 experimental trainers already work this way, so I went with autoloading rather than making... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/7519)

workarounds.symptom: Gemma 4 checkpoints are rejected for assistant-only loss: The chat template is not training-compatible
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Support assistant-only loss for the Gemma 4 chat templates. Target files: trl/chat_template_utils.py, tests/test_chat_template_utils.py, trl/chat_templates/gemma4_training.jinja. This PR makes `assistant_only_loss=True` work for the Gemma 4 checkpoints: `google/gemma-4-E2B-it`, `google/gemma-4-E4B-it`, `google/gemma-4-12B-it`, `google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it` and `google/gemma-4-31B-it`, and the re-uploads that ship one of their earlier template revisions. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8493)

workarounds.symptom: Re-uploaded models are rejected when their chat template only adds or drops the trailing newline
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Match chat templates that only add or drop the trailing newline. Target files: trl/chat_template_utils.py, tests/test_chat_template_utils.py. This PR makes TRL recognize a chat template that differs from its stored copy only by the trailing newline, so `add_response_schema` and `get_training_chat_template` accept re-uploads such as the RedHatAI Gemma 4 checkpoints. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8503)

workarounds.symptom: Tests fail with transformers<5.15 for AsyncGRPO on Qwen3.5: ValueError: Tree packing of Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration's gated DeltaNet layers requires transformers>=5.15.0
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Skip the AsyncGRPO Qwen3.5 tests before transformers 5.15. Target files: tests/test_async_grpo_trainer.py. This PR skips the AsyncGRPO tests that use the tiny Qwen3.5 models when transformers is older than 5.15.0, where the trainer refuses tree packing of their gated DeltaNet layers. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8407)

workarounds.symptom: CI fails for experimental tests with min versions: AttributeError: 'Gemma3CausalLMOutputWithPast' object has no attribute 'last_hidden_state'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix AsyncDistillationTrainer VLM compatibility with transformers < 5.0. Target files: trl/experimental/async_distillation/async_distillation_trainer.py. This PR lets `AsyncDistillationTrainer` train vision-language students with transformers < 5.0, by running the backbone through `.model` on those versions. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8462)

workarounds.symptom: CI fails with min versions: ValueError: DeepSpeed Zero-3 is not compatible with passing a `device_map`.
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Reset the global ZeRO-3 config at the end of the PEFT + ZeRO-3 SFT test. Target files: tests/test_sft_trainer.py. This PR resets the process-global DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 config at the end of `test_train_with_peft_config_and_deepspeed_zero3_forces_reentrant`, so it no longer leaks into later tests on the same xdist worker. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8448)

workarounds.symptom: `all-linear` LoRA on LFM2-MoE or gpt-oss raises a needless peft upgrade error (peft<0.19) or a false skipped-layers warning (peft 0.19 to 0.21)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Only check MoE LoRA coverage for models whose targets peft remaps. Target files: trl/trainer/distillation_trainer.py, trl/trainer/dpo_trainer.py, trl/trainer/grpo_trainer.py. This PR stops the MoE LoRA checks from raising or warning on models whose `target_modules` peft never maps onto the fused experts, such as LFM2-MoE and gpt-oss. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8428)

workarounds.symptom: AsyncGRPO test_train_model_dtype fails intermittently in CI with latest and dev dependencies: "Rollout worker child has failed" (previously a 4-hour hang)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Train the AsyncGRPO fp16 test for one step so the model cannot collapse. Target files: tests/test_async_grpo_trainer.py. This PR makes `test_train_model_dtype` of AsyncGRPO train for a single step, so it no longer hangs CI for 4 hours. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8421)

workarounds.symptom: Muse Glimmer is rejected for assistant-only loss since its latest chat template revision: The chat template is not training-compatible
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Recognize the Muse Glimmer chat template revision that states the JSON response format. Target files: trl/chat_template_utils.py, tests/test_chat_template_utils.py, trl/chat_templates/muse_glimmer_v2.jinja. This PR makes TRL recognize the chat template that `meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B` ships since 2026-11-18, so `SFTTrainer` with `assistant_only_loss=True` works again at the latest revision. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8467)

workarounds.symptom: BEMACallback breaks when any parameter is frozen
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix BEMACallback when some parameters are frozen. Target files: trl/trainer/callbacks.py, tests/test_callbacks.py. `BEMACallback` keeps only the trainable parameters, but wrote them into the BEMA model by position over all of its parameters. As soon as one parameter is frozen (e.g. the embeddings, or a VLM vision tower), the two lists shift and the first BEMA update crashes (`The size of tensor a (152064) must match the size of tensor b (32)` with the tiny Qwen2). The update now looks up each BEMA parameter by name, with the... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8455)

workarounds.symptom: CI fails with latest and dev dependencies: test step killed with exit code 137
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Build the stand-in vLLM server's sampling masks only for the requests that return them. Target files: tests/test_async_grpo_trainer.py. This PR makes the AsyncGRPO tests' stand-in vLLM server build the per-token candidate sets only for the `/inference/v1/generate` requests that return them, restoring the test jobs' memory use. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8430)

workarounds.symptom: CI emits AsyncGRPO test server BrokenPipeError: [Errno 32] Broken pipe
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Skip AsyncGRPO test server requests whose client has disconnected. Target files: tests/test_async_grpo_trainer.py. This PR makes the AsyncGRPO tests' vLLM stand-in server skip a request whose client has disconnected, as vLLM does. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8379)

workarounds.symptom: CI emits torch UserWarning: Sparse invariant checks are implicitly disabled
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Skip torch's sparse invariant checks for GOLD's X-Token projection matrix. Target files: trl/experimental/gold/gold_trainer.py. This PR makes the GOLD X-Token loss opt out of torch's sparse invariant checks explicitly, which silences the warning torch emits when the choice is left implicit. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8393)

workarounds.symptom: Support Nemotron-H in AsyncGRPO
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Rewrite the AsyncGRPO tests on the layout of GRPO's tests. Target files: tests/test_async_grpo_trainer.py. Part of #7841. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8146)

workarounds.symptom: CI fails with latest vLLM for GRPO structured outputs: AssertionError: assert 0.6377995014190674 < 0.1
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Check the log-prob gap only on the first step in the GRPO structured outputs test. Target files: tests/test_grpo_trainer.py. This PR makes `test_train_vllm_structured_outputs` check the vLLM/trainer log-prob gap on the first logged step only, instead of on every step. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8261)

workarounds.symptom: SFTTrainer saves `output_router_logits=True` in the config of the MoE models it trains
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Keep the router config of the loaded model in models saved by SFTTrainer. Target files: trl/trainer/sft_trainer.py, trl/trainer/utils.py, tests/test_distillation_trainer.py. > [!IMPORTANT] > **To be included in the release note** > > **Action needed for MoE models fine-tuned with `SFTTrainer` v1.7.0 to v1.17.1.** These versions saved `output_router_logits=True` in the model config (#6085), so the saved models return their router logits at every forward, inference included. This PR stops writing it, but keeps the config the m... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8103)

workarounds.symptom: CI fails with min versions: RuntimeError: head_size should be a multiple of 8
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Skip running the SFT Flash Attention xfails on torch versions that leak checkpoint hooks. Target files: tests/test_sft_trainer.py. This PR stops running the expected Flash Attention failures of `test_train_vlm_flash_attention` on torch < 2.13, so they no longer break later tests on the same worker. Fix #8302. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8303)

workarounds.symptom: [AsyncGRPO] `AsyncGRPO` `add_response_schema` not gated on `self.tools` (diverges from `GRPOTrainer`)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Don't require a response parser in AsyncGRPO when there are no tools. Target files: trl/experimental/async_grpo/async_rollout_worker.py, trl/experimental/async_grpo/openenv_harness.py, tests/experimental/test_async_grpo_trainer.py. , supersedes #5748. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8242)

workarounds.symptom: `DPOTrainer` crashes on the first step when `use_weighting=True` is combined with a loss_type containing "sft"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Apply the WPO weights out of place, so `use_weighting` works with the `"sft"` loss. Target files: trl/trainer/dpo_trainer.py, tests/test_dpo_trainer.py. With `use_weighting=True`, `DPOTrainer` multiplied `per_sequence_loss` in place by the WPO weights. For the `"sft"` loss, `per_sequence_loss` is a scalar expanded to the batch size, so all its elements share one memory location and PyTorch raised a `RuntimeError` at the first training step. As agreed in the issue, this PR multiplies out of place instead, and adds `test_train... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/7651)

workarounds.symptom: compute_flops_per_token fails on Gemma 4, whose head_dim is per layer
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Only estimate FLOPs for the model types the formula describes, and omit MFU otherwise. Target files: trl/experimental/async_distillation/async_distillation_trainer.py, trl/experimental/async_grpo/async_grpo_trainer.py, trl/trainer/utils.py. `compute_flops_per_token` reads config fields that most MoE families name differently, so AsyncGRPO and AsyncDistillation crash at the end of the first step on 8 of 9 tiny MoE checkpoints and on Gemma 4. They also log a wrong MFU for hybrid models like Qwen3.5 or Gemma 3. It now returns `... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8236)

workarounds.symptom: CI fails with vLLM for GRPO structured outputs: AssertionError: Parameter model.layers.1.self_attn.k_proj.bias has not changed.
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Require top_k for GRPO structured outputs with the vLLM importance sampling correction. Target files: trl/trainer/grpo_config.py, trl/trainer/grpo_trainer.py, tests/test_grpo_trainer.py. This PR makes GRPO with vLLM structured outputs and the importance sampling correction require `top_k > 0`, so that the trainer normalizes its log-probs over the tokens the grammar allows. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8145)

workarounds.symptom: CI fails with dev dependencies for DeepSeek training chat templates: jinja2.exceptions.UndefinedError: 'dict object' has no attribute 'content'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Hotfix CI: Xfail DeepSeek assistant-mask tests on transformers>=5.23.0.dev0. Target files: tests/test_chat_template_utils.py. This PR marks the DeepSeek training chat template assistant-mask tests as expected to fail with transformers>=5.23.0.dev0. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8215)

workarounds.symptom: CI fails with vLLM for PEFT with a tied lm_head: ValueError: 'lm_head.weight' was skipped because it is tied to 'model.embed_tokens.weight'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Raise when PEFT trains separate copies of tied embeddings with vLLM. Target files: trl/generation/vllm_generation.py, tests/test_grpo_trainer.py, tests/test_rloo_trainer.py. This PR makes vLLM generation fail fast when a PEFT model trains separate copies of tied word embeddings, and makes the vLLM PEFT tests of GRPO and RLOO train a single tied copy. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8144)

workarounds.symptom: GRPO crashes on Qwen2-VL / Qwen2.5-VL with transformers < 5.3.0 when a completion ends with `<|vision_start|>`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Widen the tiny Qwen2.5-VL text model so Flash Attention accepts its heads. Target files: scripts/generate_tiny_models/for_conditional_generation/qwen2_5_vl_for_conditional_generation.py, tests/experimental/test_async_grpo_trainer.py. Part of #6857. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8148)

workarounds.symptom: Tiny GLM-5.3-Flash model fails its forward pass: AssertionError: Bs must be 3D (num_experts, N//block_n, K//block_k), got ndim=2
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Drop the FP8 quantization from the tiny GLM-5.3-Flash script. Target files: scripts/generate_tiny_models/for_conditional_generation/glm5_next_for_conditional_generation.py. This PR drops the FP8 quantization from the tiny GLM-5.3-Flash generation script, so that the model is saved in bf16 and its forward pass runs. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8119)

workarounds.symptom: GRPO with vLLM: `repetition_penalty` drives the importance sampling ratio to 0 and stalls training
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Raise when GRPO combines `repetition_penalty` with the vLLM importance sampling correction. Target files: trl/trainer/grpo_config.py, tests/test_grpo_trainer.py. vLLM applies `repetition_penalty` to the log-probs it returns, and the trainer recomputes them without it, so the importance sampling correction (on by default) drives the ratio to ~1e-28 and the gradient to 0 with no error. `GRPOConfig` now raises for this combination, like AsyncGRPO does for `top_p` without `top_k`, and points to `vllm_importance_sampling_correcti... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/7915)

workarounds.symptom: SFT: `padding_free=True` is refused with any `max_length`, although truncation now runs in dataset preparation
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Stop refusing `padding_free=True` with `max_length` in SFT. Target files: trl/trainer/sft_trainer.py, tests/invariant/test_invariant.py, tests/test_sft_trainer.py. SFT raised when `padding_free=True` met any `max_length` (including the default 1024) without packing. The guard dates from when truncation lived in the collator, which padding-free bypassed. Truncation now runs in dataset preparation for padding-free too, so the guard only blocked a valid config. It's removed. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8077)

workarounds.symptom: MoE aux loss: `AttributeError: ... has no attribute 'num_experts'` on Granite MoE, granite-4.0-h and PhiMoE
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix the MoE aux loss on configs without `num_experts` (Granite MoE, granite-4.0-h, PhiMoE). Target files: trl/experimental/async_distillation/async_distillation_trainer.py, trl/trainer/utils.py, tests/test_utils.py. The fused LM head and AsyncDistillation read the expert count from `config.num_experts`, which Granite MoE, granite-4.0-h and PhiMoE configs do not define (only `num_local_experts`). Both now read the count off the router logits, which also drops the gpt-oss special case from #5754. Hybrid checkpoints without exp... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/7919)

workarounds.symptom: GRPO/RLOO + vLLM: a PEFT adapter with `modules_to_save` crashes at the first weight sync
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Skip the other adapters' `modules_to_save` copies in the vLLM weight sync. Target files: trl/experimental/async_distillation/async_distillation_trainer.py, trl/experimental/async_grpo/async_grpo_trainer.py, trl/experimental/online_dpo/online_dpo_trainer.py. With a pretrained adapter, GRPO (when `beta != 0`) and RLOO add a "ref" copy of the adapter for the reference model. When the adapter has `modules_to_save`, the vLLM weight sync stripped only the `modules_to_save.default.` prefix, so it also sent the frozen `lm_head.modul... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8079)
